name: Marketingforce Management Ltd
summary: Marketingforce Management Ltd, an investment holding company, engages in the artificial intelligence application business in China. It provides cloud-based marketing and sales services and intelligent talent management services. In addition, the company provides marketing, sales, commercial, analysis, smart, and organizational cloud DHR. It offers its solutions to retail consumption; car travel; B2B manufacturing; financial industry; enterprise services; enterprise going global; school business; domestic substitution; private domain marketing; and public domain customer acquisition industries. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
